summary_en: Fujikura Kasei authorized acquisition of up to 700,000 shares (2.5% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥700 million through on-market purchase on TSE from November 2, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, the board of directors of Fujikura Kasei Co., Ltd. authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will purchase up to 700,000 shares (representing 2.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥700 million through on-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 2, 2026 to January 29, 2027.

The company stated that the purpose of this share buyback is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital management policies. As of September 30, 2026, the company had 28,499,074 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and held 2,350,926 treasury shares. Following a cancellation of treasury stock resolved on September 28, 2026 and completed on October 9, 2026, the company held 50,926 treasury shares as of the authorization date.
